description: This Java class implements the LoanPointInTimeService interface, providing functionality to retrieve loan data at a specific point in time, including recalculating schedules, removing transactions predating the specified date, and handling arrears calculations. It employs Spring's @Service annotation and transactional management, and integrates with various other domain services and data classes.

classes.name: LoanPointInTimeServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the LoanPointInTimeService interface, providing methods to retrieve loan data at specific times, validate inputs, and manage recurring calculations and data modifications related to loans.

methods.name: retrieveAt
methods.description: Retrieves the details of a specific loan at a given date, recalculating the schedule and arrears as needed. It temporarily sets the system date context to the specified date, performs data retrieval and adjustments, and then rolls back any database changes.

methods.name: retrieveAt
methods.description: Overloaded method to retrieve multiple loans' data at a specific date, following similar validation as the single retrieve method, and ensuring transactional rollback after execution.

methods.name: removeAfterDateCharges
methods.description: Removes charges from the loan that have effective due dates after the specified date.

methods.name: removeAfterDateTransactions
methods.description: Removes loan transactions that occurred after the specified date.

methods.name: validateSingularRetrieval
methods.description: Validates that the input loanId and date are not null, throwing validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: validateBulkRetrieval
methods.description: Validates the list of loan IDs and date for bulk retrieval, ensuring they are not null or empty.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if there are any validation errors collected during input validation.
